newsitem.title: FRANCE: ALPINE SKIING-ALPHAND FASTEST IN DOWNHILL PRACTICE.
newsitem.headline: ALPINE SKIING-ALPHAND FASTEST IN DOWNHILL PRACTICE.

text.p: France's Luc Alphand, the downhill World Cup leader, confirmed he would be the favourite to win Saturday's men's downhill on home snow in Chamonix when he clocked the fastest time of the race's first practice on Wednesday.
The 31-year-old Frenchman, winner in Val Gardena and Bormio this season, left his main rivals trailing by more than one-and-a-half minutes in 1:49.42.
Swiss Urs Lehmann was second, 1:30 behind, and fellow Frenchman Adrien Duvillard was third a further 0.16 seconds back.
Chamonix will host a downhill on Saturday and a slalom on Sunday as well as the first combined event of the men's season.
